title: An Analysis of Role Semantics in Directed Dynamic Graph Modeling for Edge Classification
abstract: arXiv:2602.23135v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Edge classification on directed dynamic graphs is critical for understanding evolving user-item interactions and behavioral patterns in recommender systems and social platforms. Existing dynamic graph architectures typically process these interactions using shared parameters for nodes with semantically distinct roles, including source, destination, query, and neighbor. While abundant supervision in tasks such as link prediction provides sufficient gradient signal for models to implicitly deduce role semantics and overcome this conflation, there are often far fewer labels available for edge classification. We hypothesize that in such regimes, the ability of models to implicitly separate roles is restricted, degrading downstream performance. translated_title: 有向动态图建模中用于边分类的角色语义分析
translated_abstract: 有向动态图上的边分类对于理解推荐系统和社交平台中不断演变的用户-物品交互及行为模式至关重要。现有的动态图架构在处理这些交互时，通常对语义角色不同的节点（包括源节点、目标节点、查询节点和邻居节点）使用共享参数。在链接预测等任务中，充足的监督信号为模型提供了足够的梯度信息，使其能够隐式地推断角色语义并克服这种混淆；然而在边分类任务中，可用的标签往往少得多。我们假设在这种情形下，模型隐式区分角色的能力会受到限制，从而导致下游性能下降。为了实证研究这一关系，我们为基于序列的模型引入了一个实验框架，通过针对性的嵌入显式地解耦功能角色……
tldr: 该研究发现在标签稀少的有向动态图边分类任务中，现有模型对源、目标、查询、邻居等语义不同角色的节点共享参数会限制角色的隐式区分并降低性能，为此提出了利用针对性嵌入显式解耦功能角色的实验框架来验证这一假设。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that in label-scarce edge classification on directed dynamic graphs, shared parameters for semantically distinct node roles (source, destination, query, neighbor) limit models' implicit role separation and degrade performance, and introduces an experimental framework that explicitly disentangles functional roles using targeted embeddings to empirically investigate this hypothesis.
